scope: one matched diagnostic repeat, Restaurants eight questions per arm; no claim of statistical significance

main_failure_patterns: The agent often identified the right high-level workflow but changed a gating condition or fallback rule inside the dataflow, producing plausible outputs with wrong membership.

The largest long-horizon failure was incorrect reuse of prior customer-coverage state: Task 6 recomputed coverage for all units instead of preserving the Task 5 verified coverage artifact and the unproven-coverage rule.
A later rollback/sensitivity task inherited the wrong Task 6 coverage state while also introducing a fresh current-turn reporting error for service-screen diagnostics.

The agent repeatedly used the wrong inherited customer-coverage artifact, recomputing reach for all units instead of preserving the limited Task 5 first-customer coverage state and treating missing coverage as unproven.
The agent misapplied service-screen semantics by comparing day-type-relative slow rates against an incorrect local baseline and then letting those wrong service flags drive later boundary decisions.
Several wrong answers came from violating explicit current-turn formulas or gates while otherwise using the intended broad workflow.
